title: D-Bus: the system message bus
description: D-Bus lets processes call methods and emit signals on named buses (system bus for hardware/services, session bus for desktop). It is how the desktop asks the system to sleep. The bus is the nervous system of a Linux session.

demo.program: print('system bus: hardware/services; session bus: desktop')
demo.expected_output: system bus: hardware/services; session bus: desktop

title: enable vs start
description: systemctl enable wires a unit into boot targets (persistent); systemctl start runs it now (transient). Enable is for always, start is for now. The distinction matters.

demo.program: print('enable = at boot; start = right now')
